label: PvDeviceState
info:
Reads PV Device State from registers:
- 634-635: Total PV Energy (0.1kWh, U32)
- 629-633: Day PV Energy + Daily PV1-4 (0.1kWh)
- 772-775: PV1-4 input power (1W)
- 776-783: MPPT 1-4 Voltage/Current (0.1V, 0.1A)

Triggers:
1. RPC: getPvDeviceState
2. Manual inject

name: Prepare read (Total Energy 634-635)
Prepare read (Daily Energy 629-633)
Prepare read (MPPT Power 772-775)
Prepare read (MPPT V/I 776-783)
Build PvDeviceState JSON
Prepare RPC Response
THREE-PHASE: RPC Only (getPvDeviceState) - 4 parallel reads for PV data
